Convenience
  • Unresponsive driver assistant - a reaction to inaction. Maybe you fell asleep. Maybe you lost consciousness. No matter how it happens, Unresponsive driver assistant works to help lessen the danger when it does. It detects prolonged driver unresponsiveness, automatically bringing the vehicle to a stop and turning on the hazard lights. If equipped, emergency services will also be contacted. Unresponsive driver assistant is safety that never sleeps.
Safety and Security
  • Hands-on cruise control with lane change - Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control with lane change, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up, and helps you make lane changes. Meet your ultimate co-pilot, hands-on cruise control with lane change.
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
Technology and Telematics

Performance
Under the hood sits a twin-turbocharged 4.4-liter V8 engine that delivers a commanding 523 horsepower. Paired with a smooth-shifting eight-speed automatic transmission and an advanced all-wheel-drive system, this powertrain moves the vehicle from zero to 60 mph in a swift 4.6 seconds. Standard all-wheel steering drastically reduces the turning circle, giving this full-size luxury vehicle the agility of a much smaller car. The standard electronic air suspension operates with proactive dynamic response, utilizing navigation data to read the road ahead and iron out imperfections.

Design
The exterior design is a masterclass in modern understatement, highlighted by standard 22-inch diamond-turned alloy wheels, premium LED headlights, and a sliding panoramic roof. Moving inside, the cabin is an oasis of bespoke craftsmanship. The autobiography trim elevates luxury with premium semi-aniline leather seats, an SV bespoke duo-tone leather headlining, and natural brown walnut veneers. Every touchpoint feels deeply considered, emphasizing continuous clean lines and minimalist layout structures.

Technology
Central to the technological experience is the Pivi Pro infotainment setup, anchored by a curved 13.1-inch floating glass touchscreen that offers responsive haptic feedback. This system integrates seamlessly with wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto. Drivers are treated to a high-resolution 13.7-inch interactive driver display and an intuitive head-up display that projects vital driving metrics directly onto the windshield. Rear occupants enjoy dual 11.4-inch high-definition screens to ensure absolute connectivity on long journeys.

Advanced Safety Features
Peace of mind comes standard through an array of sophisticated driver assistance systems. A highly precise 3D surround camera network provides exceptional visibility around the perimeter, working in tandem with front and rear parking aids. The comprehensive safety suite includes adaptive cruise control with steering assist, blind spot assist, lane keep assist, emergency braking, and a rear traffic monitor to protect passengers.

Convenience and Comfort
Unrivaled luxury is felt in every seat, starting with 24-way heated, cooled, and hot-stone massage electric front seats. Rear passengers enjoy executive class comfort seats, complete with power recline and four-zone climate control. Additional high-tier details include a front center console refrigerator compartment for keeping refreshments perfectly chilled, soft-close doors, a powered gesture tailgate, and an immersive Meridian signature sound system utilizing a high-output multi-speaker setup.

  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.

Theres a kind of restrained confidence to the 2023 INFINITI Q50 LUXE that feels almost tailor-made for people who appreciate style without spectacle. It doesnt arrive demanding attention so much as collecting it naturally. The shape is sleek and low, with proportions that suggest motion before the engine even starts. Its stance feels planted and intentional, like a sedan that knows the value of looking composed in every settingfrom a downtown curb to a late-night highway sweep.

The exterior design carries a polished, athletic character. The front end has a distinctive expression that feels sharp but not severe, while the body lines flow with a deliberate grace that keeps the car from ever feeling generic. Its the sort of design that rewards a second look: subtle creases, careful surfacing, and details that make the silhouette feel more premium than flashy. The Q50 LUXE doesnt try to reinvent the sedan formulait refines it, trimming away clutter and leaving behind something quietly elegant.

Inside, the cabin continues that same idea of thoughtful restraint. The Q50 LUXE feels like a space built for comfort and focus, with materials that give the interior a warm, upscale personality. Seating is inviting and supportive, designed to keep the driver settled and the passengers relaxed. The layout is straightforward in a good way: everything feels placed with intention, making the cabin easy to live with and easy to appreciate. Theres a sense of intimacy here, like the car is inviting you into its own private rhythm.

On the road, the Q50 LUXE delivers a driving experience thats composed and reassuring. It feels balanced in everyday use, with responses that are smooth and predictable, making routine driving feel polished rather than routine. The sedans character is one of quiet capabilityit isnt trying to dominate the road, but its absolutely ready to carry itself with confidence when asked. That makes it appealing for drivers who want a car that can handle commutes, errands, and longer stretches without ever losing its sense of calm.

What stands out most is how the Q50 LUXE blends practicality with presence. It has the feel of a proper daily driver, but one that brings a little luxury into the ordinary. Its not overcomplicated, not overdone, and not desperate for approval. It simply feels well put together, with enough style and substance to make every trip feel a notch more elevated.

In short, the 2023 INFINITI Q50 LUXE is polished understatement on four wheelsclean, confident, and pleasantly upscale. Its for the driver who wants a sedan that feels elegant without effort and premium without pretense.

Theres a confident kind of swagger to the 2025 Mercedes-Benz GLE 53 AMG® 4MATIC®the sort of SUV that arrives with a tailored suit, excellent posture, and just enough mischief to make everything feel more interesting. It doesnt look like its trying to dominate the road so much as own its lane. The stance is wide and planted, the body is sculpted with that familiar Mercedes-Benz polish, and the AMG touches sharpen the whole presence into something more athletic, more alert, more ready for action.

From the outside, the GLE 53 feels like a perfect balance of luxury and intent. The front end has a purposeful expression, with a grille and lighting signature that make it seem both sophisticated and slightly impatient. Its proportions are generous without being bulky, and the flowing side surfaces give it a sense of motion even when parked. It has the visual language of an SUV that knows it can carry people, gear, and expectationswhile still looking good pulling up anywhere.

Inside, the cabin is where the GLE 53 really flexes its personality. It feels like a high-end lounge that happened to become a performance machine. The materials are rich and carefully chosen, the seats are deeply supportive, and the whole environment carries a sense of crafted calm. The cockpit wraps around the driver with a sleek, modern feel, while the tech and trim create an atmosphere thats both upscale and sharply contemporary. Its a space that makes commuting feel like a privilege rather than a chore.

On the road, the GLE 53 AMG® 4MATIC® brings the kind of energy that keeps things interesting. The powertrain feels eager and responsive, delivering quick confidence when you ask for it and smooth composure when you dont. The steering and chassis work together with a kind of polished athleticism that makes the vehicle feel substantial yet surprisingly nimble for its size. Whether its weaving through city traffic or stretching out on the highway, it carries itself with a pleasing combination of force and refinement.

What makes it especially compelling is that it never loses its luxury identity in the pursuit of performance. It can be brisk, assertive, and thrilling, but it still feels like a Mercedes-Benz firstquietly opulent, intelligently designed, and deeply comfortable. Thats the magic of the GLE 53: its an SUV that can do the serious stuff without ever forgetting how to make the experience feel special.

In short, the 2025 Mercedes-Benz GLE 53 AMG® 4MATIC® is athletic luxury with immaculate mannersbold enough to excite, refined enough to impress, and polished enough to make every drive feel like an occasion.

Get ready to meet your next dream ride! We're thrilled to showcase this stunning Iridescent Pearl Tricoat 2025 Chevrolet Suburban Premier SUV. It's a high performance machine that's perfect for growing families, weekend road trippers, and anyone who loves hitting the road with ultimate confidence. Under the hood, you'll find a powerful 5.3L V8 engine paired with a smooth 10 speed automatic transmission. It delivers a fun, responsive drive whether you're cruising down the highway or running errands around town. Plus, with a completely clean CARFAX report, you can drive off the lot with total peace of mind.

Step inside this 2025 Chevrolet Suburban Premier SUV and you'll find a cabin designed for luxury and total comfort. The beautiful perforated leather seats are both heated and ventilated up front, keeping you comfortable in any weather. Your passengers will love the heated second row bucket seats and the third row power folding bench that makes cargo space a breeze to manage. On chilly mornings, you'll love the heated steering wheel and the convenience of the power sliding center floor console. Everything about this 2025 Chevrolet Suburban Premier SUV is built to make your daily drives feel like a first class vacation.

Technology is everywhere in this 2025 Chevrolet Suburban Premier SUV. It comes fully equipped with a built in Google navigation system to help you find your next destination effortlessly. You'll love the wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto setup, which lets you connect your smartphone without messy cords. There's even a wireless phone charger to keep your battery full on long trips. For entertainment, everyone can enjoy the incredible audio quality that brings your favorite music and podcasts to life during every single journey.

Safety is always a top priority, and this 2025 Chevrolet Suburban Premier SUV has you covered from every angle. It features advanced tech like automatic high beam headlights, rain sensing wipers, and a helpful rear parking camera that makes squeezing into tight spots easier than ever. The Magnetic Ride Control suspension ensures a smooth, stable ride for everyone on board, while the built in security system gives you extra protection when parked. It's the ultimate combination of style, utility, and safety.

We want to make sure you have all the facts before you buy. This vehicle is a wholesale to the public vehicle, meaning it has undergone a thorough safety inspection. However, it's important to note that despite passing these inspections, vehicles may still have underlying issues, like cosmetic blemishes such as scratches, dings, or dents. We encourage prospective buyers to inquire for further details regarding the vehicle's condition and history before making a purchase decision. Come visit us today and let us exceed your expectations!

The Sovereign of the Highway: 2024 Chevrolet Suburban High Country 4WD
Elevate your familys travel standard to the absolute pinnacle of luxury, space, and class-leading highway range. This 2024 Chevrolet Suburban High Country is a pristine One-Owner, Clean CARFAX recent arrival that stands as the ultimate expression of Chevrolet's flagship full-size SUV. Eye-catching in its brilliant Radiant Red tintcoat exterior over a tailored Jet Black Perforated Leather cabin, this four-wheel-drive (4WD) titan pairs the track-tested precision of Magnetic Ride Control with the revolutionary fuel efficiency of the 3.0L Duramax® Turbodiesel engine.

The Duramax® Advantage: Unrivaled Torque & Efficiency
Bypassing traditional gas-guzzling V8s, this High Country features an elite powertrain calibrated for relentless highway range and effortless towing muscle:

3.0L Duramax Inline-6 Turbodiesel: Delivering a smooth 277 horsepower and a massive 460 lb-ft of low-end torque right at your fingertips.

Astonishing Fuel Economy: Earns a class-leading, budget-friendly 20/26 City/Highway MPG rating. This spectacular efficiency allows you to cruise right past the gas stations on cross-country road trips.

10-Speed Automatic Transmission: Seamlessly channels the diesels immense torque profile, providing silky, linear acceleration whether you are merging onto MoPac or hauling a heavy load.

2-Speed Active AutoTrac® Transfer Case: Features a true low-range gear set for serious 4WD capability, paired with Hill Descent Control to manage steep ranch paths with ease.

High Country Elegance: First-Class Passenger Opulence
The top-tier High Country package completely reimagines the Suburban interior, transforming the massive three-row cabin into a luxury mobile estate:

Perforated Heated & Ventilated Front Seats: Outfitted with 12-way power adjustments and custom memory settings to keep you perfectly temperature-regulated through severe Texas summers.

Dual-Pane Power Panoramic Sunroof: A sweeping glass canopy that arches over the first two rows, flooding the expansive interior with natural sunlight at the touch of a button.

Power Release 2nd-Row Bucket Seats: Captain's chairs provide business-class passenger comfort and fold forward at the touch of a button, opening effortless access to the 3rd-Row Power-Folding Split-Bench.

Bose® 10-Speaker Surround Sound: Features premium CenterPoint® technology, converting the acoustically insulated, whisper-quiet cabin into a private three-dimensional concert hall.

Hands-Free Power Liftgate: Swipe your foot under the rear bumper to easily open the rear cargo bay when your hands are full of luggage or groceries.

Next-Gen Digital Command Tech
15-Inch Multi-Color Head-Up Display (HUD): Projects critical driving parameters, active safety alerts, and navigation routes directly onto the windshield so your eyes never leave the road.

Rear Camera Mirror w/ Washer: Transforms your traditional rearview mirror into a high-definition digital screen, completely bypassing rear passengers or cargo to give you an unobstructed live video view behind the vehicle.

HD Surround Vision Grid: Links multiple external cameras to project a seamless 360-degree bird's-eye perspective on the main center display for stress-free parking.

Proactive Driver Safety & Convenience
Adaptive Cruise Control & Lane Change Alert: Automatically manages safe highway following distances while actively monitoring your blind spots for hidden vehicles.

Enhanced Automatic Emergency Braking: Works alongside Rear Cross Traffic Alert and Rear Pedestrian Alert to act as an extra set of defensive eyes through congested urban school zones.

Wireless Charging & Remote Start: Fire up the engine and pre-cool the leather cabin from your smartphone or key fob while safely powering your device on the integrated charging pad.

The 2024 INEOS Grenadier Station Wagon Trialmaster Edition is a One-Owner, Clean CARFAX recent arrival engineered from the ground up to be the ultimate spiritual successor to classic mechanical overlanders, fortified with world-class modern engineering. Finished in a rugged Beige / Tan exterior over an industrial-chic Gray Leather interior, this Trialmaster Edition is explicitly built to tackle the most extreme off-road terrain on earth straight from the factory showroom.

The Trialmaster Build: Extreme Overlanding Armor
Named after the legendary Belstaff Trialmaster jacket, this edition is configured specifically for hard-core off-roading, expedition travel, and self-sufficiency in the wilderness.

Raised Air Intake (Snorkel): Protects the engine against dust and water ingestion during deep river crossings or dusty overland convoy trails.

Auxiliary Battery & High-Output Switch Panel: Features an overhead, aircraft-inspired cockpit switch console pre-wired to an auxiliary battery, allowing you to seamlessly plug in winches, exterior light bars, and overland refrigerators without draining your main starter battery.

Exterior Utility Belts: Integrated door and quarter-panel tie-down tracks that let you attach recovery gear, fuel canisters, or storage packs directly to the outside of the vehicle.

3.0L Turbocharged Inline-6 Engine: Sourced directly from BMW, this smooth, high-torque powerplant produces 282 horsepower and 332 lb-ft of torque, delivering massive low-end grunt perfectly suited for technical off-road crawling.

ZF 8-Speed Automatic Transmission: The gold standard of modern gearboxes, delivering seamless, predictive shifts on-road and durable power distribution off-road.

Full-Time 4WD & Tremendous Articulation: Built on a heavy-duty box-section ladder frame chassis with heavy-duty Carraro solid beam front and rear axles, offering incredible wheel travel and mechanical durability.

The Industrial-Chic Cabin
The Grenadier interior ingeniously balances analog durability with premium digital connectivity, featuring hose-out rubber flooring with drain plugs alongside high-end seating surfaces.

Gray Leather Seat Trim: Premium, supportive, and highly ergonomic Recaro-designed front bucket seats that mitigate body fatigue during long, jarring trail expeditions.

Advanced Navigation & Technology System: Features a crisp center touchscreen display that houses full smartphone mirroring alongside an integrated off-road navigation pathfinder system that works even when completely out of cellular range.

Exterior Parking Camera Rear: Offers high-definition visibility behind this boxy overland titan, ensuring stress-free maneuvering in both dense forest trails and tight Austin parking spots.

18" Alloy Wheels: Wrapped in rugged, aggressive all-terrain tires designed to withstand sharp rocks and highway commutes with equal composure.

The Covert Commitment
Serving Central Texas and beyond since 1909, the Covert family has spent over a century building an impeccable multi-generational legacy of trust, transparency, and top-tier guest care. Visit us at 11750 Research Blvd, Austin, TX to experience the "Covert Commitment" firsthand and see why the incredibly rare 2024 INEOS Grenadier Trialmaster Edition is the definitive choice for you
